features: Adds Live Screen Projector as the third main Scoring Dashboard option beside Manual and Automatic Scoring
Adds live competition selection page for projection control
Adds round-aware Heats, Semifinal and Final projection control pages
Heats controls include Judges, Competitors, Scoring Status and Callback Reveal
Semifinal controls include Judges, Competitors, Scoring Status and Finalists Reveal
Final controls include Judges, Finalists, Scoring Status, Final Ranking and Winner Reveal
Winner projection supports individual 5th, 4th, 3rd, 2nd and 1st reveals plus Show All Top 5
Adds audience-safe 9:16 projection views and keeps temporary admin scoring tables off the public presentation
Scoring sheets gain direct navigation to the current round Projection Control
Existing shared secure competitor Stage Display remains the competitor projection foundation
No scoring calculation or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
